title: Ghost IDE 1.1.2
massges:
# 🚀 What's New

## ✨ New Features
- 🖥️ Added Terminal
- 🌍 Added Android Project Language Translation
- 🌙 Added Background Mode
- 🪟 Added Split View for the Code Editor (optimized for tablets)
- 💻 Added multiple programming languages (see `README.md`)
- 🔗 Added clickable link preview
- 🖼️ Added image preview support
- 🌐 Added FTP & SFTP support
- 🛍️ Added Store (Beta)
- 📊 Added Editor Status Bar (will be expanded in future updates)
- 📁 Added File Tree inside the Code Editor for faster file and folder navigation
- 🔋 Added Power Saving Mode (disables animations when the battery threshold is reached)
- 🎨 Added a background to the Settings screen
- 🔥💧 Added custom app icons (Fire & Water themes)

## ⚡ Improvements
- 📂 Improved file reading and management

## 🛠️ Bug Fixes
- ✅ Fixed download issues
- ✅ Fixed project creation issues
- ✅ Fixed text filtering bugs
- ✅ Fixed code editor search bugs
- ✅ Fixed **Save All** in the Code Editor
